The '''Snow Mynock''' was a variant of the [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]], a [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]]-based parasitical [[Species/Legends|species]] often found within [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]], that had found its way to the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
